## Rules

- Key binds immutable request identity and content hash; two distinct requests never overwrite one object, identical replay may reuse exact hash object. Fetch DB row and object reference are finalized consistently after checked write using P3.2 pattern. Retention is documented separately from immutability-within-retention. No raw credentials/query secrets in paths. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/research-01-remediation-architecture.json`, D5).

## Guidance

Regression writes same run/offset across two days and price intervals with different bytes; assert two paths and each fetch reads its original body. Repeat identical request and assert idempotent reference/no duplicate object where supported. Repeat HTML tab across revisions and assert distinct identities. Inject false/exception write and assert no Fetch claims artifact_ref. Do not use timestamp alone; include stable request identity/hash to avoid collision. This item may execute after GO without changing P4.3 verdict.
